title: The Mole and the Bone
lines: A mole digs a hole at home.
In the hole is a big bone.
The bone is stuck in a stone.
Mole gets a rope and a pole.
He tugs the rope with his nose.
Mole tugs it home to his den.
He naps with the bone on his nose.

questions.ask: What is the bone stuck in?
questions.listenFor: A stone. This is stated in the story, so send them back to the line rather than saying it for them.

questions.ask: What two things does Mole use to pull the bone?
questions.listenFor: A rope and a pole. If they name only one, ask "and what else did he get?"

questions.ask: Do you think the bone was worth all that work? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. Listen for a reason, such as "yes, because he naps with it at the end."
